headline: Mapanuepe Lake Boat Capsize Death Toll Rises to Eight
seoTitle: Mapanuepe Boat Capsize Death Toll Rises to 8 | FMB News
seoDescription: Eight Aeta passengers have died after a boat capsized in Mapanuepe Lake, while responders continue searching for one missing pregnant woman.
deck: Responders recovered the bodies of two missing children on August 29, while the search continued for one pregnant adult passenger.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The death toll from the Mapanuepe Lake boat capsize rose to eight after the bodies of two missing children were recovered on Saturday, August 29, authorities said.
The motor banca carrying 13 Aeta passengers capsized near the Sunken Church in Barangay Buhawen, San Marcelino, on Thursday, August 27. Four passengers survived.

sections.heading: Search for the missing
paragraphs: Residents found one child at about 10:10 a.m., and search, rescue and retrieval teams recovered the second child at about 11:05 a.m., according to local reporting based on authorities.
Responders continued searching for the remaining missing passenger, a pregnant adult woman. Difficult weather and lake conditions have complicated the operation.

sections.heading: What authorities know
paragraphs: The passengers were members of an Aeta community in Sitio Lumibao and were returning from Barangay Buhawen after receiving food and medicine and attending a vaccination program, according to the Coast Guard.

Initial accounts indicated that the motorboat encountered strong winds and rough water before capsizing. The Coast Guard said the circumstances remained under investigation, so the precise cause has not been established.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The victims were returning to their community in Sitio Lumibao after traveling across the lake for a vaccination activity. Residents rely on boats to reach the main part of Barangay Buhawen.
This update keeps the developing tragedy on its established canonical route and replaces the earlier count of six deaths and three missing passengers.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The tragedy highlights the risks faced by communities that depend on small boats during rapidly changing monsoon conditions and the need for timely local weather and water-safety guidance.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for an official update on the remaining missing passenger and the Coast Guard investigation into the circumstances of the capsize.
